lane: SQL + Edge + Admin: per-feature AI context data blocks (n8n-style node graph), Owner request 14/11
goal: Let Admin see, for every AI feature, which data reaches the model as a chain of nodes (input, data blocks, prompt layers, model route, output checks, answer) and, for persona_chat, daily_insight and ai_council, switch each personal data block off or lower its limit through Draft -> Review -> Publish. A new versioned table ai_context_configs with draft/publish RPCs, a shared Edge helper that reads the active row with a short cache and falls back to today's behaviour, and an Admin page 'Dữ liệu gửi cho AI'. Caps equal today's values, so a config can only send less data; crisis screening, consent, the data-block separation, the no-journal-text rule and the provider data-class rule stay enforced in Edge code. Oracle, Tarot and both Astrology features are shown read-only. Nothing is applied or deployed by the agent.
successCriteria: docs/proposals/AI_CONTEXT_CONFIG_2026-11-14.vi.md lists every field that reaches the model for all seven features with source, data class, consent gate, current limits and code location, and records the design and Owner decisions.

Migration 20261114090200 adds public.ai_context_configs (one active and one draft row per feature, RLS on, no client grants, service_role select) and get_ai_context_configs (ai.read), save_ai_context_config_draft (ai.manage or ai.read + content.draft) and publish_ai_context_config (ai.manage, note 10-500), all security definer with search_path '', advisory lock, audit rows and 22023 for unknown blocks, wrong types or out-of-range limits.
packages/agent-config/ai-context-blocks.json is the one block spec; the SQL mirror and the Admin copy are checked equal by tests.

With no table, no active row, an empty blocks object or every block on at its cap, ai-persona-chat, ai-daily-insight and ai-council send byte-identical model messages to cb32621 (golden fixtures captured before the edit).

Hard rules hold whatever the config says: crisis screening and safetyText use the full message before context is built; locked fields cannot be switched off; limits are clamped to today's caps; no journal text block exists; the request data class is never below the feature floor and rises with enabled blocks; user values never enter the system prompt.

Admin page 'Dữ liệu gửi cho AI' (#context) shows the node graph per feature in Vietnamese, toggles and limits for configurable blocks, locks with reasons, read-only graphs for the other four features, Lưu nháp and Xem lại & phát hành with diff and note, the unsaved-changes guard and RPCs registered in NilazaAdminRpc.

PGlite replay of the migration, Deno tests, jsdom Admin tests, validate:backend, supabase:check, validate-admin-workflow-catalog, validate-admin-contract and preflight --ci pass (known Windows CRLF-only failures excepted).

impact.entryPoint: Admin AI Studio route #context 'Dữ liệu gửi cho AI' in the Tính năng AI group; Edge Functions ai-persona-chat, ai-daily-insight and ai-council through the shared context-config helper.
impact.dataWrite: New table ai_context_configs (draft/active/archived rows of block switches and limits); admin_audit_logs rows ai.context_config.draft and ai.context_config.publish. No user data stored.
impact.backendContract: Three new RPCs; app request and response shapes unchanged; model messages unchanged when no config is active; trace metadata gains contextConfigVersion only when a config is active.
impact.adminVisibility: Per-feature node graph with data class and limit on every data node, lock reasons, draft/active versions, diff before publish and audit history.
impact.privacySafety: Configs can only remove data or lower limits within today's caps; crisis screening, consent, data-block separation, no journal text and the provider data-class floor are enforced in Edge code and cannot be configured.
impact.observability: contextConfigVersion and the existing nicknameSent/goalCount/historyTurns/moodSent trace fields show what was sent; audit rows record who published which version.
impact.rollback: Publish a version with every block on (or the defaults) to restore today's messages; the helper ignores a missing table and errors; redeploying the previous function versions removes the reader.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Record and preflight before the first code edit; migration and deploys left to the Owner by hash; PGlite, Deno and jsdom tests only; PLAN.md updated in the same branch.

skillReview.name: nilaza-ai-runtime
skillReview.evidence: Every Admin field has a runtime consumer in the three Edge Functions; crisis screening runs before context building; user data stays in the data block; provider data class respected; default parity proven against golden fixtures.

dependencyReview.evidence: Only repository code and migrations are used; PGlite is installed in the session scratchpad, not in the repository.

securityReview.authzRls: ai_context_configs has RLS on, no policies and no grants to anon/authenticated; reads through get_ai_context_configs (ai.read); drafts through save_ai_context_config_draft (ai.manage or ai.read + content.draft); publish through publish_ai_context_config (ai.manage only); all security definer with search_path '' and audit rows; Edge reads with the service role.
securityReview.sensitiveData: The table stores switches and numbers only, never user data. Configs can only reduce what is sent; caps equal today's limits and Edge clamps again.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secret read or logged; the helper uses the existing service key env read pattern and never returns it.
securityReview.externalInput: SQL rejects unknown blocks and fields, wrong types and out-of-range integers (22023); Edge ignores unknown keys and clamps numbers; Admin escapes every value.
securityReview.dependencies: No package added to the repository.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Owner applies 20261114090200 by hash and redeploys ai-persona-chat, ai-daily-insight and ai-council; until then Admin names the missing migration and functions behave exactly as today.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if default parity fails, if any config can raise a limit above today's cap or switch off crisis screening, or if any test or check fails for a non-CRLF reason.
